page.overview:
Who is Princess Skystar?

Princess Skystar is a female seapony/Hippogriff who appears as a supporting character in My Little Pony The Movie and a central character in the chapter book Beyond Equestria: Fluttershy Balances the Scales. She also makes minor appearances in the chapter book The Stormy Road to Canterlot and the season nine episode The Ending of the End - Part 2. She is the princess of the underwater kingdom of Seaquestria and the daughter of Queen Novo.

Kristin Chenoweth mentioned in an October 6, 2015 Twitter reply, "I get to help pick my mane color."

My Little Pony The Movie art director Rebecca Dart reveals in the art book The Art of My Little Pony: The Movie that Skystar originally had two sisters named Haven Bay and Salina Blue. However, when the writers decided to make Skystar an only child, the sisters became background characters.

Princess Skystar, as well as Queen Novo, was designed by Rebecca Dart.
